dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL
evidence: No EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, consistent with GnuCOBOL open-source stack

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — monthly billing detail file creation for short-term benefits and self-pay receipts
purpose.summary: ORCR0480 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software suite. It reads indexed receipt data files (patient insurance info, disease names, point/amount claim summaries) and produces monthly receipt detail output files for short-term insurance and self-pay categories. It handles editing of disease names, treatment periods, and claim counts, and writes error and date files.

notable_features: 35 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter convention
Multiple indexed sequential files (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED)
OCCURS tables for hospital/system master data
Large working-storage with Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
223 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments; content is clearly readable COBOL. Part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 140853 bytes (3290 lines total); analysis based on first ~450 lines plus mechanical indicators.
